correctness.rationale: The four blowup exceptional curves and six line transforms have the disjoint-pair adjacency of KG(5,2), with each intersection transverse and one point. In particular the triangle-free graph rules out a triple point, each geometric rational component has three nodes, and the genus is 15-10+1=6. This model and the S5 action are characteristic-independent. I computed the reduced Laplacian determinant 2000 and used a successive-difference basis and exact Hermite/Smith calculations of the coinvariant presentation for all seven cycle types. The geometric factors are (2,10,10,10); the resulting pairs of fixed primary dimensions in Finding order are (4,3),(2,2),(2,1),(0,1),(0,0),(1,0),(0,1), agreeing also as integral groups, by the equivariant monodromy pairing. In the record's separate modular approach the reduced action includes movement of the deleted vertex and the elementary primary parts really are quotients by p; hence the augmented-matrix rank computes fixed dimensions even when the permutation order is divisible by p. For the conditional Néron assertion, over the strict henselization the split multiplicity-one components give the degree-zero multidegree lattice modulo the intersection matrix. Off-diagonal intersections count geometric nodes and diagonal entries are minus the degrees because the full fiber has zero intersection with each component. Thus this Raynaud presentation is the graph group, functorial for residue-field action; rational points of the component scheme are geometric Frobenius invariants. This does not assert a smoothing exists or calculate the connected special-fiber Jacobian.
residual_risks: The component-group application is restricted to the specified regular thickness-one case; it is not an unconditional existence result or a claim about arbitrary weighted graphs.

value.rationale: The graph is the full canonical ten-curve boundary, not a selected subgraph. The integral table answers a natural finite degeneration question for every twist: in the mixed case it establishes that the group of rational components can be trivial despite 2000 geometric components, and it specifies full group type in the remaining cases. This is useful independently of the connected torus table and the known nonequivariant Smith form, without relying on an unproved universal smoothing existence claim.
residual_risks: No general classification for other degenerations or other divisors follows from this finite calculation.
